title: LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs
abstract: arXiv:2609.33470v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. translated_title: LiveOption：在具有非线性收益的结构化期权交易中评估大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型和多智能体系统在金融决策方面已展现出潜力，然而现有的评估主要集中于股票交易，且主要考察方向性预测，忽视了衍生品市场的结构复杂性。期权交易带来了根本不同的挑战，包括非线性收益和多腿策略构建，这要求结构化决策而非简单的方向性押注。我们提出了LiveOption，一个用于期权交易中基于大语言模型智能体的评估框架。LiveOption将该问题形式化为现实执行与资本约束下的结构化序贯决策，并提供了一个具有标准化交互协议的可复现环境。该框架包含三个任务套件，涵盖投资组合叠加、事件驱动的财报交易以及0DTE日内交易。我们进一步提出了一个分层指标套件，用于评估智能体的实际……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了LiveOption评估框架，在真实执行与资本约束下，通过涵盖非线性收益与多腿策略构建的三类期权交易任务，弥补了现有评估仅关注股票方向性预测的不足。
en_tdlr: LiveOption is an evaluation framework that assesses LLM agents in structured option trading—featuring nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction—under realistic execution and capital constraints, addressing the limitations of existing evaluations that focus solely on directional equity trading.
